IF F53132310000, SEE F53132310001: PN F53132310001 CAN REPLACE PN F53132310000 UNDER CONDITIONS(A). PN F53132310000 CAN REPLACE PN F53132310001 UNDER CONDITIONS(B). (A) IF THE A/C IS NOT FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 NOT INSTALLED), THEN INSTALL AN AIRWORTHY CAP ON ALL ANTENNA CONNECTORS AS IT IS SAID IN THE SB INFORMATION SYSTEM-FLIGHT OPERATION PERIPHERALS-INSTALL ANTENNAS ON  RADOME FOR FOMAX #A330-46-3162. IN THE TASK A330-A-46-XX-3162-01000-93AA-A AND SUBTASK A330-A-46-XX-3162-02001-720A-A. NOTE: IN CASE OF LIGHTNING STRIKE ON THE RADOME, THE INSPECTION TASK MUST CHECK THAT THE CONNECTOR CAP IS STILL IN PLACE. IF THE A/C IS FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 INSTALLED), THEN: -CONNECT THE FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER RADOME. -RE-ACTIVATE THE FOMAX AS PER MAINTENANCE TASK. (B) IF THE A/C IS FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 INSTALLED), THEN: -DE-ACTIVATE THE FOMAX AS PER MAINTENANCE TASK. -ON A/C SIDE, PROTECT AND ATTACH OF THE MOBILE COAX CONNECTOR AS PER AIPS 07-01-001. ON THE REMOVED RADOME-ANTENNA, PROTECT THE ANTENNA CONNECTOR WITH A CAP.

PN F53132310001 CAN REPLACE PN F53132310000 UNDER CONDITIONS(A). PN F53132310000 CAN REPLACE PN F53132310001 UNDER CONDITIONS(B). (A) IF THE A/C IS NOT FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 NOT INSTALLED), THEN INSTALL AN AIRWORTHY CAP ON ALL ANTENNA CONNECTORS AS IT IS SAID IN THE SB INFORMATION SYSTEM-FLIGHT OPERATION PERIPHERALS-INSTALL ANTENNAS ON  RADOME FOR FOMAX #A330-46-3162. IN THE TASK A330-A-46-XX-3162-01000-93AA-A AND SUBTASK A330-A-46-XX-3162-02001-720A-A. NOTE: IN CASE OF LIGHTNING STRIKE ON THE RADOME, THE INSPECTION TASK MUST CHECK THAT THE CONNECTOR CAP IS STILL IN PLACE. IF THE A/C IS FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 INSTALLED), THEN: -CONNECT THE FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER RADOME. -RE-ACTIVATE THE FOMAX AS PER MAINTENANCE TASK. (B) IF THE A/C IS FITTED WITH FOMAX AND FOMAX ANTENNAS UNDER THE RADOME (MOD 208363/S34847 INSTALLED), THEN: -DE-ACTIVATE THE FOMAX AS PER MAINTENANCE TASK. -ON A/C SIDE, PROTECT AND ATTACH OF THE MOBILE COAX CONNECTOR AS PER AIPS 07-01-001. ON THE REMOVED RADOME-ANTENNA, PROTECT THE ANTENNA CONNECTOR WITH A CAP.
